metadata.source: Georgia Department of Revenue — Tax Digest Consolidated Summaries
metadata.license: Source data is a public record of the State of Georgia.
notes: One row per county x tax district x tax year.
Key on (countyCode, districtCode, taxYear). District names drift between years for ~15% of districts and must not be used to join.
A null millage means the jurisdiction reported none; 0 means it levied zero. They are different facts.

countyName is canonical per countyCode; countyNameAsFiled is what that year's workbook said. DOR abbreviates some county names per row ('ATKINS', 'BENHIL', 'CHARLT TB'), giving 191 distinct names for 159 codes, so never join on a county name.
districtType is derived: codes 0-3 are statewide-stable (countywide/state/school/county_incorporated), everything above is classified from the district name.
A city school system is listed under EACH county it serves, so the same system can appear more than once in a year.
occurrence is 1 for every row except where DOR lists the same county/district/year twice (Cherokee 2022 district 18). Those rows are published unmerged; sum them only deliberately.
DOR's 2020 workbook is published as "2020-digest-excluding-charlton", so treat 2020 Charlton figures with suspicion.
